exposure: degree of physical activity during pregnancy
cohort: 150 women who gave birth from November 2021 to February 2022 at MTUTH, Ethiopia
finding: Women who engaged in vigorous physical activity were more likely to have spontaneous vaginal deliveries and shorter labor durations compared to those with light physical activity.
mod_finding: 87% of women with vigorous physical activity had spontaneous vaginal deliveries, compared to 16.5% of women with light physical activity.
